message: No detected input validation: The parse() method reads CSVs and converts columns to datetime without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or null/missing-value validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from local file paths using pd.read_csv() with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Although the project imports outlier-detection utilities (LOF, isolation_forest) in main.py, none of them are called within the data preparation flow (Dataset.parse or Dataset.combine), so no poisoning defense is applied to the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses `load_weights=True` in `create_train_activity_prediction_model` but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the code before loading pretrained weights.

No detected label distribution validation: No explicit label distribution check or class balance validation is performed before training; the weighted loss functions address imbalance but do not validate or report label distributions.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on data before it is passed to the models; data is read directly from CSV files and combined without any defensive checks.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks applied to model outputs anywhere in the visible inference code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses GRU-based time-series/sensor models, not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
